decisions.reason: As an adjacent business unit in offshore and renewable vessel management, it fits the firm's expansion path and core capabilities, so its strategic option value likely outweighs the cost of continuing.
Although travel-related demand was unusually volatile around 2020-2021, this service is closely complementary to crew management and is worth retaining until conditions fully normalize.
The online vessel information portal is a low-cost digital extension of the core offer, so real-options logic favors keeping it on the market while customer uptake continues to reveal its value.
The mobile vessel performance app supports efficiency and sustainability goals, and its likely modest carrying cost makes further market learning preferable to dropping it now.
